source.title: Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition (arXiv:1512.03385)
source.notes: Public arXiv preprint, CVPR two-column layout, 12 pages, many small result tables. Key figures are the paper's published benchmark numbers (Tables 3-6), cross-checked against the widely cited values (e.g. ResNet-152 single-model 19.38/4.49, ensemble test top-5 3.57). Built 2026-08-17, pending spot-check approval, then frozen. FROZEN 2026-08-20 (Clement spot-checked Tables 3-6 values and the abstract 3.57 against page crops and approved; any change must be recorded here).
